content.text: If you prefer a ready-to-use web search tool without building one from scratch, there are several options that integrate directly with the AI SDK.

These include Exa, Parallel Web, Perplexity, and Tavily, which can be added via their respective npm packages and configured with your API keys.

The official documentation can be found at the Vercel AI Gateway Web Search page and the AI SDK Core documentation.
